title: Checkout button returns 500 on retry
summary: Pressing checkout twice within 1s yields a 500 error and a stuck order.
expectedBehavior: Second click is debounced or returns the existing pending order.
actualBehavior: Server returns 500 and the order is left in 'pending' forever.
userImpact: Customer cannot complete purchase; revenue lost.
suggestedFixDirection: Add request idempotency on the checkout API.
acceptanceCriteria: Double-click on checkout returns 200 with same orderId
